os_disk.kind: Microsoft Q&A corrected support response; not a Swagger deletion guarantee or a live test
os_disk.author: Hemalatha (Microsoft External Staff / Moderator)
os_disk.finding: The later response reports confirmation from the Azure Local engineering team: VM deletion also removes its OS disk; data disks remain for separate removal.
os_disk.correction: The earlier response at 14:31:38 incorrectly described OS-disk retention. The implementation and tests use the corrected response, not the earlier statement.

data_disks_and_nics.finding: Associated data disks and network interfaces are retained when deleting the VM and require independent cleanup.

os_disk_identity.kind: Native 2024-01-01 REST contract, also retained in catalog/source/swagger.json

limits: No independent emulator or live Azure Local backend was used.
The action verifies each registered OS disk and guest identity resource with its own GET; operation success or VM absence alone cannot close those assets.
Physical VM/disk removal and billing termination remain unverified.

images.kind: Microsoft Azure Local FAQ; independent documentation, not a live backend test
images.finding: A VM receives a copy of its source image at creation. Gallery image deletion removes the displayed image name from VM details but does not affect the deployed VMs.

storage_paths.kind: Microsoft management documentation; not a physical backend execution
storage_paths.finding: Remove associated workloads before deleting a storage path; use storagepath show to verify absence. Volume deletion is a subsequent separate operation.
storage_paths.optional_placement: Native placement fields are optional. Missing placement cannot establish that a resource is on another path; the application retains it as a possible consumer requiring explicit review.
